csv_scope_of_work: The County of Cape May and Cape May County Bridge Commission (hereinafter County/Commission ) seek proposals from qualified firms to provide Bridge Engineering services on a competitive as-needed/project specific basis for the County/Commission s twenty-nine (29) bridges. The Firms selected are to provide all bridge engineering services required for repair and maintenance to the County/Commission bridges. The services may vary and may include securing any and all permits and approvals, development of plans of various types of electrical, mechanical and structural repairs and contract documents, inspection of specialized repair work, and live load ratings of existing members. Contracts may be awarded by both the County and Commission, and each will administer their own contracts.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
